newsitem.title: UK: Tirana airport not under govt control -- Britain.
newsitem.headline: Tirana airport not under govt control -- Britain.

text.p: Albania's Tirana airport is no longer under government control and groups of armed civilians are moving freely around the city, the British Foreign Office said on Thursday.
"There are frequent bursts of gunfire in the centre of the city. There is a risk of widespread public disorder and looting tonight," a spokesman said by telephone.
"Tirana airport is no longer in government control," said the spokesman. Earlier reports from Tirana said the airport had been closed.

The spokesman said the British embassy in Tirana had sent a convoy of more than 120 people to the port of Durres. The convoy consisted of 65 British nationals, 52 people of other nationalities, 11 Commonwealth citizens and three from Ireland.
"This convoy has now arrived safely at the port of Durres on the Albanian coast and we are hoping to evacuate them from there to Italy," the spokesman said.
Albania slid towards anarchy on Thursday as arms depots in several towns were looted and people used the weapons to raid food warehouses for emergency stockpiles.
